notes: RBox expansion paired with biology-replace-0011 (the inverse of 'preys on' becomes 'is a parasite of'): gives a made-up relation (fennopes, whose inverse is the equally made-up quorlish_to) the property the revision changes, applied to real instances in the prompt. The coined terms stay untranslated in the Chinese and Spanish prompts. hops counts the prompt facts as one bridge.
